Hi Sam — answers below and I’ve flagged items where we need a follow-up action: 

1) CacheFlow access: limited. CacheFlow runs edge caching and is only allowed to hold encrypted tokenized values (hashed identifiers) — they do not receive plaintext PII. Controlled access is enforced via ephemeral credentials; row 7 in subprocessors_2028-02.csv has the relevant policy link. If Legal wants, I can provide the access control audit excerpt (redacted).

2) Data residency: For hosted customers we are multi-region; for BorealTech-sized enterprise customers we offer Dedicated and Private deployments which can be region-locked (EU-only). That capability is a paid deployment option; I’ve noted this under a HubSpot internal comment: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5481 and copied Laura to handle pricing.

3) KMS/HSM: Redwood supports Redwood-managed KMS by default; we also offer a customer-managed KMS/HSM integration as an add-on for Dedicated/Private deployments (customer supplies key or we integrate with your KMS via our KMS connector). I’ve attached the standard KMS addendum template and marked it as optional in the DocuSign envelope.

Action items: 
- If you need the KMS/HSM addendum, please indicate and we’ll add to DocuSign for signature.
- Procurement: send PO to billing@redwood.ai and cc laura.bennett@redwood.ai (use vendor code RW-3342).
- Security/legal: if you need the redacted access audit excerpt, reply to this thread and I’ll pull it.

Thanks — once we have DocuSign complete and PO received, we’ll route to enablement and target a 5-business-day activation.

Best,
